rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N is a mandatory join key linking to Acc_Info_dirty and serves as the primary identifier for records. No missing values currently observed, but rule enforces data quality for future loads.

rule: S_N must be unique across all records
rationale: S_N acts as a unique table-level identifier with a one-to-one relationship to Acc_Info_dirty. All 30 current values are distinct.

rule: S_N must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N (one-to-one consistency)
rationale: Cross-table join hint specifies one-to-one key relationship with Acc_Info_dirty. Every serial number in the biographical table must have a corresponding entry in the account information table.

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account_No is a mandatory business identifier for customer accounts. No missing values observed in current dataset.

rule: Account_No must be a 4-digit numeric code
rationale: Evidence shows Account_No values range from 1001-1028 with exactly 4 characters. Stored as int64 but intended as string identifier.

rule: Account_No must not be duplicated (flag for business review)
rationale: Evidence identifies 2 repeated values (1001, 1010) requiring clarification whether these represent valid shared accounts or data entry errors.

rule: Name must not be null
rationale: Customer name is a mandatory biographical field. All 30 records currently populated.

rule: Name must be in Title Case (flag all-uppercase or all-lowercase values)
rationale: Evidence shows case deviations: 'WANG SHI JIE' (all uppercase) and 'lim wei jie' (all lowercase) require standardization to Title Case.

check_params.logic: any((w[0].islower() if w else False) or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: Name cultural particles must be consistent with Gender (Bin/s/o indicate Male; Binte/d/o indicate Female)
rationale: Dataset contains Malay/Indian naming conventions where 'Bin'/'s/o' denote male and 'Binte'/'d/o' denote female. Sample contains these particles across multiple records.

check_params.logic: (re.search(r'\b(Bin|s/o)\b', str(row['Name']), re.IGNORECASE) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'male') or (re.search(r'\b(Binte|d/o)\b', str(row['Name']), re.IGNORECASE) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'female')

rule: ID_No must not be null
rationale: National ID number is a mandatory unique identifier. No missing values observed.

rule: ID_No must conform to Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one uppercase letter (S,T,F,G), 7 digits, one uppercase checksum letter
rationale: 93.3% of values follow format S1234567A. Evidence flags 8-character anomalies '1916569C' (missing prefix) and 'F212233V' (6-digit middle) as requiring validation.

rule: Race must not be null
rationale: Race is a mandatory demographic classification field. All 30 records populated.

rule: Race must be one of the standard Singapore ethnic categories
rationale: Evidence shows values limited to Chinese, Malay, and Indian categories. Canonical values use Title Case per standard naming conventions.

rule: Race must be standardized to Title Case (flag MALAY, malay, indian)
rationale: Evidence identifies casing inconsistencies: 'MALAY', 'malay', 'indian' require standardization to 'Malay', 'Indian'.

rule: Gender must not be null
rationale: Gender is a mandatory demographic field. All 30 records populated.

rule: Gender must be Male or Female
rationale: Evidence shows binary classification with values Male and Female. Canonical representation uses Title Case.

rule: Gender must be standardized to Title Case (flag male, FEMALE)
rationale: Evidence identifies case deviations 'male' and 'FEMALE' that require standardization to 'Male' and 'Female'.

rule: Age must not be null
rationale: Age is a mandatory demographic field. All 30 records populated.

rule: Age must be numeric (flag non-numeric text like 'Twenty-five')
rationale: Evidence identifies 1 non-numeric value 'Twenty-five' (3.3% of records) that cannot be parsed as a number.

rule: Age must be between 0 and 120 years (inclusive)
rationale: Domain constraint for human age. Evidence shows values -5 and 66; negative values and values exceeding 120 are biologically implausible.

rule: Age must not be negative
rationale: Age is inherently non-negative. Evidence shows value -5 which violates this constraint.

rule: Age should be at least 13 years for service account validity
rationale: Business rule: Evidence flags values below 13 (4 and -5) as potentially unrealistic for a service account, requiring verification.

rule: Contact_No must not be null
rationale: Contact number is mandatory for customer communication. Evidence shows 6.7% missing values (2 records) requiring population.

rule: Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number
rationale: Dataset contains Singapore-based customers with country code +65 observed in 17.9% of records. Singapore country code is 65.

rule: Contact_No local number must contain exactly 8 digits
rationale: Singapore phone numbers use 8-digit local format. Evidence identifies '8964359' with only 7 digits as anomalous.

rule: Email must not be null
rationale: Email is a mandatory contact field. All 30 records populated.

rule: Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace
rationale: Evidence identifies 4 malformed emails (13.3%): 'not-an-email', 'useremail.com' (missing @), 'zx91 @example.com' (space), 'nabilah@@example.com' (double @).

rule: Email must be lowercase (flag mixed or uppercase characters)
rationale: Email standardization requires lowercase to ensure uniqueness and consistency. Unicode emails are case-sensitive but conventionally stored lowercase.

rule: Country must not be null
rationale: Country is a mandatory address field. All 30 records populated.

rule: Country must use the canonical values: Republic of Singapore, S'pore, SG, Singapore, Singapura, 新加坡
rationale: Evidence shows 8 distinct variants of Singapore (Singapore, SINGAPORE, singapore, SG, S'pore, Singapura, 新加坡, Republic of Singapore). Flag values not matching these patterns.

rule: Street_Name must not be null
rationale: Street name is a mandatory address component. All 30 records populated.

rule: Street_Name must be in Title Case (flag all-uppercase values)
rationale: Evidence identifies 'HOLLAND ROAD' as all-uppercase deviation requiring standardization to 'Holland Road'.

rule: Postal_Code must not be null
rationale: Postal code is a mandatory address field. All 30 records populated.

rule: Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
rationale: Singapore postal codes are 6 digits. Evidence shows values with 4 digits (6907) and 5 digits (99999) suggesting truncation or foreign formats.

rule: Account_No must match the corresponding Account_No in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: Cross-table consistency: For each S_N, the Account_No in the biographical table must be identical to the Account_No in the account information table.

check_params.semantic_check: Account_No values must be identical between tables for matching S_N

rule: ID_No must match the corresponding ID in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: Cross-table consistency: For each S_N, the ID_No in Cust_Bio_dirty must match the ID field in Acc_Info_dirty. Sample shows mismatch for S_N 16 (S8421753J vs S8421753X).

check_params.semantic_check: ID_No must exactly match the ID field in sibling table for matching S_N

rule: Name must match the corresponding Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N (allowing for case differences)
rationale: Cross-table consistency: For each S_N, the customer name should be consistent between tables. Sample shows variations like 'junrong' vs 'Lim Jun Rong' and 'Danish' vs 'Danish Bin Kamaruddin' requiring alignment.

check_params.semantic_check: Name must match Full_Name between tables for matching S_N (case-insensitive comparison)
